measurementPolicy.headline: No weighted aggregate is permitted. Every applicable denominator is reported separately.
measurementPolicy.completionRule: Strict completion requires full Canvas source-zone atomization, exhaustive force classification, and an atom-specific test that observes the atom's real project job: performing, deriving, projecting, enforcing, constructing, validating, controlling a genuine choice, or supplying an exact grammar fact or explanation. An owner link, file, label, semantic assertion, or existence test is insufficient.
measurementPolicy.grammarAuthority: Only typed grammar owners authorize results. Canvas atoms supply specification and provenance.
measurementPolicy.evidencePolicy: Evidence neither authorizes grammar nor blocks a result when absent.
measurementPolicy.uiPolicy: Only genuine grammatical choices become controls; derived, contextual, lexical, boundary-conditioned, evidence, and presentation facts do not.

sourceScope.warning: The 28,540-atom denominator is exhaustive for Lessons 1-58 only. It is not a full-Canvas denominator until the eight non-lesson zones have current atom ledgers.
